name: Build & Deploy
description: Loads a build configuration, executes the Unity build, monitors progress, and verifies the output artifact.
toolGroupNotes: Every tool in this workflow (manage_build, manage_asset) is in the bridge's default-on `core` group, so no manage_tools activation step is needed. Builds go through manage_build; manage_editor has no build action. `action: "settings"` requires a `property` (product_name, company_name, version, bundle_id, scripting_backend, defines, architecture) -- pass `value` to write, omit it to read. `scripting_backend` accepts only `mono` or `il2cpp`. The `options` array accepts only clean_build, auto_run, deep_profiling, compress_lz4, strict_mode and detailed_report. On Unity 6.4 the Build Profiles window hides classic platforms by default (Project Settings > Editor > Build Profiles > Hide Classic Platforms) -- source: https://docs.unity.com/en-us/engine/6000.6/manual/whats-new/unity64, retrieved 2026-10-21. See steering/build-automation.md.

steps.name: Load build configuration (read current Player Settings before building)
Monitor build progress via job status and console
